calls.title: Dripify Campaign
calls.summary: The team discussed strategies to boost attendance for an upcoming event, setting a goal of 30 attendees with a 40% show rate, requiring around 50 invites. They introduced Dripify as a tool for automated LinkedIn outreach, capable of sending up to 500 invitations over 10 days, while highlighting the need to manage invites to avoid overlaps. The target audience consists of Bay Area VPs in engineering, product, and data science within companies with 500 to 10,000 employees, totaling approximately 1,500 prospects. Team roles were clarified, with each member responsible for specific segments to ensure effective outreach without duplication. The importance of adhering to LinkedIn’s limits on daily invites was also underlined to maximize campaign success.
calls.keywords: Dripify, LinkedIn outreach, Sales Navigator, event attendance, ProSP AI, prospect nurturing
